experiment: Held-out evaluation v1.0, minimum scope (docs/HELDOUT_PROTOCOL.md, 'Minimum scope v1.0')
status: frozen with method freeze v1.0 (docs/FREEZE.md), before any held-out base, mutant or contract exists

targets.buggy: the 2 mutants generated at C4, one per base, named in the C4 manifest
targets.negative_controls: the 2 unmutated bases; each is also its mutant's corrected variant

runner: experiments/heldout-v1/run_heldout.py (C1b), which refuses to run from any other path or if freeze/manifest.py check fails; outputs only under experiments/heldout-v1/results/ and experiments/heldout-v1/sealed/ (manifests of sealed material), raw logs under runs/
order: buggy targets before controls; within a target, for each seed in order: M0, M1, M3+, M3+arg, M4, A2. If the model cost cap stops the run, every model trial not started is reported as not run, with its place in this order

notes.A2: identical to the A2 ablation (experiments/2026-10-28-a2-no-source/config.json): methods.run_m4 with include_source false
notes.verification: the pilot's, plus inconclusive_reruns 2 (D-030), for every target
notes.seeds: the same 20 seed numbers for every method. M0, M1 and M3+ draw from their own streams (M3+arg shares M3+'s); M4 and A2 have no seed, so a seed number only labels a fresh planning session
notes.cap: strict, as in A2: a model call is refused when spend so far plus per_call_reserve_usd would exceed model_cost_cap_usd. The cap needs the owner's approval before any held-out model call
notes.model retries: the pilot's rule (run_pilot.LiveModel): up to 3 attempts on transport errors, HTTP 429 and 5xx, waiting 5 s then 15 s; failed attempts count as model latency
notes.crash rule: a trial that ends in error is re-run once with the same seed; both are reported. The analysis uses a Muse trial's first attempt (an error is a failure, never a fresh draw) and a baseline's second (docs/FREEZE.md §4, rule 3)
